text: Reading that makes me even more worried about the practical effects of a 2030 petrol‑car ban on people like me. At the same time I don’t want to be reflexively anti‑environment; if the transition were managed with real help for low‑income and rural households — big subsidies, cheaper second‑hand EVs, much better charging in villages and on rural roads, and support for tradespeople and farmers — I’d be less hostile. Right now the message just makes me more concerned that the policy is rushed and could unfairly hurt people like me unless the details and support are much stronger.
